Scope: 44 ready-built factories of 900 m² each in 11 blocks (B1–B11), with external utilities, roads, parking and street lighting.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours (225,761 man-hours in total). At the 27-Oct-2026 data date the project is 80.0% complete against 79.2% planned, 0.8% ahead. The lead comes from testing and commissioning and external works; construction of the factory blocks is 1.0% behind, and Blocks B4 and B5 are each about 23% behind their plan.

On plan overall, but almost no float is left at the finish. The P6 update finishes the project on 03-Mar-2027, three days before the contract completion date of 06-Mar-2027, with zero float on project completion. Of the 99 activities in progress, the weekly report counts 98 as behind schedule, and failed-start activities rose from 205 to 270 this week. Construction is 73.6% complete against 74.6% planned.

The weekly report and the P6 update use different baselines for the discipline milestones. For civil works the weekly report's baseline is 21-Feb-2027, while the P6 baseline is 01-Oct-2026 and the P6 forecast 21-Nov-2026, 51 days after its own baseline. The contractual milestone for site levelling, local roads and parking (P6 baseline 12-Feb-2026) has still not started and is forecast for the data date itself.

Data notes

  • The weekly report workbook (WPR #36, .xlsb) has no text version in MD Files, so its figures were read from the original workbook in All Files.
  • No earlier week has been uploaded for this project, so progress this week, the "this week" quantities and the weekly gain are shown as "—".
  • The workbook's weekly physical figures disagree with each other: the Progress sheet gives 3,981 planned and 5,797 earned man-hours this week, the report page 4,323 and 4,538, its WBS rows add up to 4,019 and 4,354, and its block rows add up to 3,945 earned. None was used for the weekly rate.
  • Block B6 shows 437 of 11,824 man-hours earned (3.7%) against 91.9% planned, while the progress tracking sheet shows B6 complete for structure, walls and first-fix works and a photo shows its cladding. This also lowers the construction total.
  • Testing and commissioning is recorded at 40.6% earned against 13.6% planned, while the Testing sheet shows mechanical testing 8% complete and electrical and fire testing not started.
  • The report page's headline plan and earned values, the P6 layouts and the Risk & Issue log ("Planned progress … Actual progress …") are cost-based; the log labels this cost-based figure as actual progress. This report uses the physical (man-hour) figures only.
  • The weekly report's general information gives a forecast completion of 06-Mar-2027 (no variance), while its milestone sheet and the P6 update give 03-Mar-2027.
  • Discipline milestone baselines in the weekly report differ from the P6 baseline (for example civil works 21-Feb-2027 against 01-Oct-2026). The survey milestone is shown as achieved on 14-Jan-2026 in the weekly report and on 12-Feb-2026 in P6.
  • Material delivery completion is 13-Oct-2026 in the report summary and 27-Sep-2026 in the milestone sheet. The procurement sheets carry project ID DAM-05-009, not DAM3-05-11, and the tracker marks only 20 of 83 purchase orders as issued.
  • The P6 file's project code is DAM3-02-3 with a planned start of 14-Mar-2023, which does not match this project.
  • The invoice summary shows 0 submitted invoices although six are listed and approved.
  • The Risk & Issue log names Engr Hamdi as MODON PM; the weekly report names Engr. Affat M. Al-Enezi. Its dashboard shows 245 open risks and 130 open issues, against 6 open risks and 2 open issues in the logs.
  • The general information sheet still gives the project stage as "Mobilization". In Major Quantities the backfill unit is written "m4" (shown here as m³), and BOQ item 2.1.4 is used for two items.
